'''Xer VIII's mother''' was the wife of [[Xer VIII's father]], mother of [[Xer VIII]] and grandmother of [[Xim/Legends|Xim]]. In the play ''[[The Pirate Prince]]'', it is suggested that her husband was unfaithful to her.
